edge_explainer: QUEUE PREMISE WHEN-ISSUED CONTAMINATED (the ADIG lesson again): 'DUMP_THEN_BASE -23% since dist 01-02' measures off the 01-02 close of $46.65 on 106k shares. First TRUE regular-way session was 2026-01-05 on 12,049,661 shares at $40.57, from which the decline is -9.2%. IBKR's 52w high of $58.42 is a when-issued artifact from mid-December prints on ~1,000-share volume. And the pattern is NOT dump-then-base: it is dump (-32.4% to 02-13) -> RALLY +62.0% to 05-15 -> fade. VSNT is +34.3% above a low that is ~117 sessions old = decisively LATE. Cheap on the numbers: EV $7.13B / 3.01x TTM adj EBITDA, 0.82x net leverage, 4.07% dividend, ~17-21% normalised FCF yield. But FY25 FCF of $1,855M is a pre-interest pre-standalone-cost CARVE-OUT figure and Q1-26 FCF of $558M is flattered twice (cash interest $31M vs $52M expensed; cash taxes $11M vs $205M accrued) - neither annualisable. The -1.1% Q1 revenue headline is a mix illusion: carried by content licensing +$64M (a Kardashians library deal, timing not run-rate) while LINEAR DISTRIBUTION, 60% of revenue, ACCELERATED its decline to -7.3%. Subscribers -8% in each of 2024 and 2025; ratings -17% in 2025; management issues no guidance and no terminal decline rate. Fails RP_FAIR: the carry is a 4.1% dividend against cash flows declining 5-8%/yr and the terminal-value tail is neither bounded nor cheap to hedge. REVIEW FLAG (not ELEVATE): Comcast was 18.0%/17.8%/13.9% of revenue in 2023/24/25 as a related party; post-separation 'transactions with Comcast are not considered related party transactions' (10-Q Note 10) so a ~14-18% distributor concentration VANISHED from the filings on a technicality. Dual-class: 377,775 Class B at 15 votes = 33-1/3% of voting power held entirely by Brian L. Roberts.
